00107 template<class ValueType, class KeyType = Text>
00108 class Dictionary : public SmartPointerContainer< DictionaryInternal<ValueType,KeyType> >
00109 {
00110 public:
00111   typedef KeyValuePair<ValueType,KeyType> KeyValuePairType;
00112   typedef ObjectArray<KeyValuePairType> KeyValuePairArrayType;
00113   
00115   Dictionary() throw()
00116   : SmartPointerContainer< DictionaryInternal<ValueType,KeyType> >
00117     (new DictionaryInternal<ValueType,KeyType>())
00118   {
00119   }
00120   
00122   Dictionary(KeyValuePairArrayType pairs) throw()
00123   : SmartPointerContainer< DictionaryInternal<ValueType,KeyType> >
00124     (new DictionaryInternal<ValueType,KeyType>())
00125   {
00126     put(pairs);
00127   }
00128     
00130   const ObjectArray<ValueType>& getValues() const throw()
00131   { 
00132     return this->getInternal()->getValues(); 
00133   }
00134   
00136   const ObjectArray<KeyType>& getKeys() const throw()
00137   {
00138     return this->getInternal()->getKeys(); 
00139   }
00140   
00142   KeyValuePairArrayType getPairs() const throw()
00143   {
00144     KeyValuePairArrayType pairs = KeyValuePairArrayType::withSize(length());
00145     
00146     for(int i = 0; i < length(); i++)
00147     {
00148       pairs[i] = KeyValuePairType(key(i), value(i));
00149     }
00150     
00151     return pairs;
00152   }
00153   
00158   ValueType put(KeyType const& key, ValueType const& value) throw()
00159   {
00160     ObjectArray<ValueType>& values = this->getInternal()->getValues();
00161     ObjectArray<KeyType>& keys = this->getInternal()->getKeys();
00162 
00163     int index = keys.indexOf(key);
00164     
00165     if(index >= 0)
00166     {
00167       ValueType& oldValue = values[index];
00168       values.put(index, value);
00169       return oldValue;
00170     }
00171     else
00172     {
00173       keys.add(key);
00174       values.add(value);
00175       return ObjectArray<ValueType>::getNull();
00176     }
00177   }
00178   
00179   ValueType put(KeyValuePairType pair) throw()
00180   {
00181     return put(pair.getKey(), pair.getValue());
00182   }
00183   
00184   void put(KeyValuePairArrayType pairs) throw()
00185   {
00186     for(int i = 0; i < pairs.length(); i++)
00187     {
00188       put(pairs[i]);
00189     }
00190   }
00191   
00192   
00195   ValueType& at(KeyType const& key) throw()
00196   {
00197     ObjectArray<ValueType>& values = getValues();
00198     ObjectArray<KeyType>& keys = getKeys();
00199     
00200     int index = keys.indexOf(key);
00201     return values[index];
00202   }
00203   
00206   const ValueType& at(KeyType const& key) const throw()
00207   {
00208     ObjectArray<ValueType> const& values = getValues();
00209     ObjectArray<KeyType> const& keys = getKeys();
00210     
00211     int index = keys.indexOf(key);
00212     return values[index];
00213   }
00214   
00217   ValueType& operator[](KeyType const& key) throw()
00218   {
00219     ObjectArray<ValueType>& values = this->getInternal()->getValues();
00220     ObjectArray<KeyType>& keys = this->getInternal()->getKeys();
00221     
00222     int index = keys.indexOf(key);
00223     return values[index];
00224   }
00225   
00228   const ValueType& operator[](KeyType const& key) const throw()
00229   {
00230     ObjectArray<ValueType> const& values = getValues();
00231     ObjectArray<KeyType> const& keys = getKeys();
00232     
00233     int index = keys.indexOf(key);
00234     return values[index];
00235   }
00236   
00239   ValueType remove(KeyType const& key) throw()
00240   {
00241     ObjectArray<ValueType>& values = getValues();
00242     ObjectArray<KeyType>& keys = getKeys();
00243     
00244     int index = keys.indexOf(key);
00245     
00246     if(index >= 0)
00247     {
00248       ValueType& removed = values[index];
00249       keys.remove(index);
00250       values.remove(index);
00251       return removed;
00252     }
00253     else
00254     {
00255       return ObjectArray<ValueType>::getNull();
00256     }
00257   }
00258

00265     int index = values.indexOf(value);
